dimensions.evidence: Executed x86-64 layouts: dual item88, hook40, list48, index control64, slot28 and handle16 bytes; second hook offset48, item alignment8. The report records GCC/Clang at O0/O2/O3 and ASan/UBSan.

Four physical items plus two lists require448 bytes; four index slots plus one control require176 bytes, excluding external handles. A second relocation destination adds112 bytes during transfer. Lists retain borrowed storage, not resource ownership.

Physical parent/list/item addresses remain stable while linked. Index owner remains stable for all surviving tokens; slot storage may move only after ending raw borrows. Release rejects linked entries and retires after generation3.

Each hook has independent ownership; mutation changes only its chain. Relocation requires disjoint typed arrays or the identical array no-op. Raw structure copying of physical items leaves stale embedded addresses.
No allocator or hidden heap storage is used by these mechanism functions. Index acquisition scans four generation/live controls and may permanently exhaust after12 issued handles.

Physical nodes cannot move while linked. Index relocation performs four typed slot assignments (112 bytes of slot storage on this ABI), then one backing-pointer publication; no handle rewrite. Pointer/member padding is ABI dependent.

Unlink both hooks then release logical identity; int payloads have no destructor. Each unlink uses bounded neighbor repairs; a resource-owning payload extension would require its own cleanup dictionary.

Actual O2 recovery code uses a48-byte address adjustment for conventional container recovery, a load at hook offset24 for explicit parent, and unchanged bits for initial-member conversion. Fold calls the external DSCombine once per visited element.
Single-owner nonreentrant protocol. Neither physical links nor stable generation handles provide concurrent reclamation or safe access through an expired owner pointer.

Full, busy, stale and invalid argument rejection occur before mutation; callback failure preserves final output but not callback side effects. The oracle covers16384 actual dual/index prefix transitions; original list enumeration covers14680064 transitions.

Exact separate translation and link commands/durations are retained for eight configurations. Public interfaces use fixed declared types and no per-payload generated monomorphization. Changing private implementation requires rebuilding that object and relinking; public layout changes require recompiling clients. A complete incremental workload timing is not inferred from clean commands.
